decisions.reason: As a supplement line that directly extends the firm's existing consumer-health, pharmacy, manufacturing, and quality capabilities, it is easier for us to improve and keep than to withdraw.
This skin and hair supplement remains very close to our established OTC and pharmacy-based knowledge base, so market feedback can be absorbed and translated into incremental refinement.

The joint-health supplement is somewhat narrower and less prominently signalled than the main line, but it still builds on related formulation, regulatory, and customer knowledge that supports continued commercialization.

Although the mushroom-based immune supplement is the most niche and uncertain of the supplement products, it is still related enough to our supplement portfolio that further learning is more attractive than immediate exit.

The OTC migraine triptan is more distant from our established offer than the supplements, but our in-house development, manufacturing, regulatory, and quality capabilities give us enough absorptive capacity to continue testing and supporting it for another year.
